$schemaNotes: Every entry carries TWO ORTHOGONAL fields: `class` (which of the four β r1 classes a PATH belongs to, for the total-partition assertion) and `writeProtected` (whether --apply refuses to touch it). They are independent predicates over the same path — see BUILD-SPEC.md 'ROOT (arc failure mode, β r3)'.

generatedViews: exact-path entries for the 5 generated views. class=1 (they are current/live content, not historical) but writeProtected=true always — the codemod never hand-edits a regenerated file. Their `warpos` occurrences get disposition=derived, never pinned (a pin would be a lie the moment the source regenerates).

pathGlobs: whole path/dir exclusions for Class 2 (operator-gated) / Class 3 (historical or detector literal living inside otherwise-live tooling) / Class 4 (wholly historical trees). writeProtected defaults to true; only Class 2 (.github/**) is protected for a DIFFERENT reason (operator/classifier gate, not history).

occurrencePins (R4): (file, matchText [, anchor]) entries for specific `warpos` literals living INSIDE otherwise Class-1 (live, gets-renamed) files. NEVER a bare line number: an edit above a pinned line must not silently break the pin. A pin must match EXACTLY ONE line of its file (the gates fail a pin matching zero lines — stale, F7 — or several — ambiguous; add an anchor). disposition=pinned.

futureEntries: paths named by the BUILD-SPEC that do not exist in the tracked tree YET (created by a later ticket). Declaring them now means their eventual creation is NOT a 'post-freeze silent addition' (F8) — the warrant already exists, dated before the freeze.

R2 allow-view: there is NO separate allow-list file. 'Where the legacy slug may remain' is a VIEW of THIS artifact — its Class-3/4 pathGlobs + futureEntries plus its occurrencePins — exposed by partition-loader.js (`allowList` / `isAllowed`). Both gates read that view through the loader only.

$freeze (F8): baselineKeys are the entry keys frozen at T2 exit (node scripts/open-source/partition-loader.js --keys). After the freeze every added entry needs an `amendments` record {key, warrant} AND its own separate commit touching only this artifact (+ the occurrence ledger) whose message carries `partition-amendment:`. The baseline itself is immutable.

$freeze.rule: F8: every entry key must be in baselineKeys or carry an amendments record {key, warrant}; a post-freeze commit that adds a key must touch only this artifact (+ the occurrence ledger), carry `partition-amendment:` in its message, and record the amendment. baselineKeys never change after the freeze commit.
